source_snapshot.procedure: On HMC run `i2ctransfer -y 0 w2@0x11 0x04 0x00 r3`; refer to PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Only generic result/photo collection and unexpected-log checks; no mapping, register definition or reply oracle.

source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: "【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). Log into the HMC and run the following command and ensure you get a reply. Refer to PID : 1114953 for other devices expected on the bus. i2ctransfer -y 0 w2@0x11 0x04 0x00 r3
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test."

test_case.test_name: Test connections between HMC I2C-3 and FPGA 2 — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify communication from HMC I2C-3 to FPGA2 through HMC bus0 by reading a defined FPGA2 register and validating the three-byte reply and path-specific error state.
required_package: PID1114953 mapping of HMC I2C-3 to Linux bus0 and FPGA2 address0x11
Expected three-byte field values/masks and endian interpretation
Confirmation the write phase only positions a read pointer
HMC bus0 driver/daemon owner and raw-access window
Timeout/NACK/retry criteria, path-specific error counters and recovery
test_case.test_command: Map HMC I2C-3 to bus0 and FPGA2 to address0x11; confirm register0x0400 is a safe read target; record ownership and HMC/FPGA2 error baseline; issue one bounded combined pointer-write/read; decode its three bytes for the installed FPGA2 firmware; compare error counters/logs and verify management health.
test_case.expected_result: 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test."

Confirm physical probing/photos are not core acceptance unless separately scoped.
safety_gate: Do not substitute FPGA1/bus3 mapping or results
Prove0x11 identity and0x0400 non-mutating semantics before raw access
Avoid concurrent access with HMC driver or management service
Run one bounded request and preserve the first failure rather than retrying automatically
Abort on wrong response length, invalid field, NACK, timeout, arbitration loss, stuck bus or HMC/FPGA2 health regression
expected_evidence: PID mapping for HMC I2C-3/bus0/FPGA2 address0x11
HMC and FPGA2 hardware/firmware identities plus bus ownership baseline
Vendor register0x0400 definition and expected three-byte decoder
Timestamped exact transaction with stdout/stderr, exit code, latency and decoded field comparison
Pre/post HMC I2C-3 and FPGA2 error/status telemetry
Post-read management health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Wistron I2C policy requires platform-management controller, bus, address, protocol, expected response and recovery. HMC bus0 must be explicitly mapped to logical I2C-3.

source_conflict.reason: The source omits the logical-to-Linux bus map,0x11 FPGA2 identity, register0x0400 semantics and expected r3 value. Both prior reviews additionally impose physical probing that the source does not request.
